name: πClideaN
author: Timo
summary: πClideaN is a 16-lane hybrid MIDI sequencer with Euclidean and custom patterns, A/B variations, per-step expression, scales, guided randomization, humanization and four dual-LFO modulation slots. Imports Microtonic Patternarium patterns and includes 150 BEST A+B patterns matching πToniC's drum kits.
